pythonRegression.skipReason: Windows-only primitive wrapper skipped on Linux; independent real Windows executions recorded separately

limitations: Historical primitive runs self-spawn under the same user; those runs alone do not establish shared-service isolation.
Integrated synthetic HTTPS and real Windows SCM/CLI service checks are separate from a production WPF reader, Web sync API or beta installer.

Logged-out refresh and an authorized Go read with domain/proof paths blocked executed in an existing domain session. Saved reader reports alone do not independently establish first-launch provenance; offline Windows cached sign-in remains unverified.
The core implements conservative cross-boot policy, but actual offline reboot/repeated reboot and shutdown/startup across expiry require separate native acceptance.
RTC progress is trusted for powered-off time; privileged coordinated trusted-state/RTC snapshot rollback and power-loss-safe directory metadata are not defeated or qualified.
